admission.justification: The mounted navigation cases distinguish an engaged reader's kept subject from an unengaged reader's late catalogue and fail when either rule is inverted.

applicability: Initial unnamed reviewer entry and a catalogue answer after SUBJECT_HOLD_MS releases task-context reading.
conditions: Pointerdown, keydown, wheel and touchstart are observed passively on the surface root; engagement is ignored while the hold is settling.
An outlined result is searched in the current persisted triage/authored order.
exclusions: No unconditional first-family or timely-first-subject promise.
A catalogue that answers after the bound selects nothing on its own.
A refused or empty catalogue supplies no fabricated subject.
statement: After the bounded unnamed-entry wait, an engaged reader keeps their selected subject, view and focus when the catalogue answers, while an unengaged reader follows initialSubject only for a catalogue that answers inside that wait; a catalogue answering later fills the navigation and selects no subject, and a named subject always wins.
